{{Quote|I'm Lord Medechas, leader of Operations Group Five. We started this riot by arming prisoners and pointing them at their Republic captors.|Lord Medechas|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Medechas''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Medechas led [[Special Operations Group Five]], which was tasked with securing the Imperial base at the [[Imperial Lodgement]] and sowing chaos in the [[Minimum Security Section]]. Medechas's forces clashed with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] security forces under [[Marshall]] [[Ellis Ruger]] during the early stages of the battle.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Medechas appears on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he is a primary character in the main Imperial world arc within the Minimum Security Section.<ref name="TOR" />
